description: This file defines the Response class in the OpenCart system, responsible for managing HTTP response headers, output content, and optional compression.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Manages HTTP response headers, output content, and compression for the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Adds an HTTP header to the response.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to a specified URL with a status code.

methods.name: setCompression
methods.description: Sets the compression level for output.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Sets the output content to be sent.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Compresses data using gzip if supported, based on headers and PHP extensions.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Outputs the stored content, applying compression if set.
